duzeltme.secenekler[0].text: $6$; from 2021 to 2025, the number of fish increases by an average of 600 fish per year.

duzeltme.secenekler[2].text: $6$; from 2021 to 2025, the number of fish increases by an average of 6 fish per year.
duzeltme.secenekler[3].text: $6$; in 2025, the number of fish is increasing at exactly 600 fish per year.
